neighbours.label: goods sold to raise money for a group or cause (a fundraiser sale), not ordinary commerce
fire: The swim team paid for its new uniforms by selling candy bars outside the supermarket.
Parents are selling raffle tickets this week to help send the choir to Vienna.
Each spring our scouts go door to door with boxes of popcorn to fund their camp.
Students set up a car wash and sold lemonade to raise money for the animal shelter.
The church ladies hold a pie sale every autumn to help pay for the new roof.
Please support the marching band by buying a few wrapping paper rolls this month.
To help the sick boy's family, classmates sold bracelets during lunch at school.
All proceeds from these holiday wreaths go directly to the volunteer fire brigade.
quiet: The sporting goods chain paid for its new warehouse by selling shoes across the region.
Agents are selling beachfront condos this week to buyers from Vienna and beyond.
Each spring our dealership moves dozens of used trucks to customers around the county.
Investors bought the car wash and sold its land to a developer from the city.
The furniture store holds a clearance sale every autumn to make room for new stock.
Please compare prices before buying a few printer cartridges from an online retailer.
To improve its margins, the company sold laptops directly to customers at its stores.
All revenue from these software licenses goes directly to the parent corporation.

notes: Probes: band selling cookies 0.80, charity raffle tickets 0.64, bake sale 0.44, against selling insurance 0.11, house for sale 0.015, shop's sales 0.03. A separate strong trigger, 'seasonal affective' (1.22), is not covered by this label or this test.
